# rundll32.exe is all Rust (rundll32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/rundll32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# rundll32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/rundll32-rust/src/rundll32/rundll32.rs)
add_cargo_module(rundll32 rundll32-cargo rundll32.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE rundll32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
